messages:
lina: Heads up 1 PR to add a compact 'cost+p95' dashboard snippet for Console: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4527
omar: skimmed. love the minimal approach. two nits: the snippet references `traceLink` which should be `trace_link` in YAML, and the Python SDK code uses old `attach_trace` helper.
pei: re: trace helper, new SDK exposes `with_trace(traceId=...)` context manager. can update the example to match current API and avoid confusion.
lina: thanks, will change to `with_trace(traceId=...)` and fix YAML key. also shortened the embedded code to 4 lines and added a GitHub link to the full example.
docs-bot: CI lint failed: docs/snippets/metrics/cost-p95.yaml (line 8): unknown key `traceLink`. See CI details: https://ci.redwood-inference/4527/logs
omar: fixed in a small follow-up commit: renamed to `trace_link` and added a comment explaining old->new mapping.
pei: ran local smoke import: import -> Dashboard shows cost column, p95, and trace link resolves to /docs/console/tracing/tracehook-v2. all good.
lina: added a short 'how to smoke-test' checklist to the PR body per docs process. requesting review from @pei and @omar.
docs-bot: PR 4527 merged by lina at 3579990120.
